changes.text: The sidebar can now be hidden on individual monitors. The Monitors page has a Sidebar switch for the selected one, and Super+Z toggles the column on the monitor you are on; hidden means fully, with the windows taking the width back.

Two new config.json keys hold the same setting: sidebar.enabled, the default every screen follows, and sidebar.perScreen, which holds only the monitors that disagree. Your config gains them by itself; nothing to do.
